description: Visit 1, then 2, then the goal. Work out each segment rather than using distances from the start. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: A negative displacement can be covered while keeping the same heading.
description: Visit the point behind the starting direction, then park at the goal. Try using reverse instead of a U-turn. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: After moving down, a left turn points right on the map.
description: Reach the lower point, then the point to its right, then the goal above it. Decide left and right from the robot heading. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Opposite sides of a rectangle have equal lengths.
description: Visit three corners in order and return to the start. Pair equal side lengths. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: One horizontal segment and one vertical segment form a step.
description: Climb three map steps in order. Find the pair of movements that repeats. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: The consecutive gaps are 200, 300, 400 and 500 mm.
description: Visit the markers on one line; the gaps grow each time. Consider storing the next distance in a variable. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Use the horizontal and vertical differences to calculate distance and bearing.
description: Visit the three survey corners in order. Work out a diagonal heading instead of using only right angles. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Equal diagonals create four equal route segments.
description: Trace all four diamond corners and return. Compare the angle turned with the interior angle. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Use a stage variable to distinguish repeated visits to the center.
description: Visit the numbered points on both loops in order. The shared center means different turns on different visits. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Reverse the order of segments, not just each direction.
description: Visit the outbound points, then return through them in reverse order. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Make a rectangle My Block and call it for each patrol area.
description: Trace a small rectangle, transfer to the next one, then trace that rectangle. Look for an inner and outer pattern. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Heading 0 points up, 90 right, 180 down and 270 left.
description: Visit north, east, south and west survey points in order. Try turn-to-heading commands. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Two neighboring legs share a length before it increases.
description: Trace the expanding spiral through all markers. Derive the next leg length from a pattern. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Alternate the vertical direction after each horizontal step.
description: Inspect alternating upper and lower markers without skipping their order. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Align one coordinate first, then approach along the other.
description: Reach the alignment point before the final narrow goal. Separate sideways positioning from the final approach. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Each command is based on the difference between the current and next point.
description: Visit markers with irregular spacing. Build a table of changes in x and y before coding. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Pass the distance into your My Block rather than copying it.
description: Follow alternating short and long legs. Reuse one movement routine with different arguments. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: A heading close to 360 degrees is close to 0 degrees.
description: Move between slanted markers across the north direction. Consider the shortest rotation across 0 degrees. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: The same position can require different actions depending on progress.
description: Pass the center, complete the top branch, return to the center and take the bottom branch. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Mirroring keeps distances but swaps left and right turns.
description: Trace one side, then its mirror. Decide which turns must change sign. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

focus: Reusing a routine at different scales
hint: A square routine needs only one length argument.
description: Complete a small square followed by a larger square. Use the same routine with a new side length. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Keep the inspection coordinate separate from your changing position.
description: Visit the inspection point, detour through the next markers, then return to the saved point. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Compute each new bearing from the next target rather than accumulating guesses.
description: Visit small target regions on alternating diagonals. Choose headings carefully to stay inside each region. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Write and test each stage before connecting the complete mission.
description: Visit the loading point, inspection area, service point and exit in that order. Give each stage a named My Block. Visit numbered checkpoints in order before the green goal.

hint: Separate inspection from pickup so the magnet is enabled only when needed.

hint: Approach different positions inside the large shared delivery zone.

hint: Read cargo color before choosing the delivery destination.
description: Deliver red and blue cargo to opposite-row destinations. The nearest zone has the wrong color.

hint: Your program can choose collection order after the mandatory inspection.

hint: Break the job into inspection, classification, transport and safe return phases.
